description: Verified, currently valid US coupons (type 'code') and code-free promotions (type 'promotion'). Brand is optional: without it, returns the newest verified coupons, optionally filtered by category. Brand/retailer 'aliexpress' returns AliExpress US code tiers with min_spend and ends_at. If a brand has no coupons, suggested_deals lists current deals of that brand. Coverage: 160+ brands with their own MoneyDeals brand page, e.g. EcoFlow, Anker, Anker SOLIX, Jackery, BLUETTI, DJI, Insta360, Roborock, Dreame, ECOVACS, Shark, Bambu Lab, Anycubic, Creality, Ninja, Levoit, Nanoleaf, Govee, Garmin, Sonos, Samsung. 8 categories: Robot Vacuums, Power Stations & Solar, E-Bikes & E-Scooters, Smart Home & Security, 3D Printers, Power Banks, Beauty Tech, Kitchen Gadgets. Use list_brands for the full list.

category.description: Optional category filter (used when no brand is given), e.g. vacuums

market.description: Market code. Only 'us' is supported today.
